description_en: Updates the configurations of a virtual private cloud (VPC) direct connection for a dedicated resource group
description_zh: 更新指定专属资源组的VPC直连配置
kebab_example: aliyun eas update-resource-dlink --cluster-id cn-shanghai --resource-id eas-r-w1ttszneb9n9940000 --vswitch-id vpc-uf66uio7md0000 --security-group-id sg-bp149cedsfx2rfs0000 --vswitch-id-list vsw-8ersw98sgmlgkxxxxxx --destination-cidrs 172.16.0.0/16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateResourceDLink

parameters.description_en: The ID of the region to which the resource group belongs.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the resource group belongs
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the resource group. For more information about how to query the ID of a resource group, see [ListResources](~~412133~~).
parameters.description_zh: 资源组的ID。如何查询资源组ID，请参见[ListResources](~~412133~~)。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. For more information about how to query the ID of a resource group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html
parameters.help_zh: 资源组的ID。如何查询资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the peer primary vSwitch. After this parameter is specified, an elastic network interface (ENI) is created in the VSwitch.
parameters.description_zh: 对端的主vSwitchID，会在该vSwitch中创建ENI。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the peer primary vSwitch. After this parameter is specified, an elastic network interface (ENI) is created in the VSwitch
parameters.help_zh: 对端的主vSwitchID，会在该vSwitch中创建ENI
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the security group to which the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance belongs.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the security group to which the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance belongs
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.description_en: The vSwitches of the clients that you want to connect to. After this parameter is specified, the CIDR blocks of these vSwitches are added to the back-to-origin route of the server.
parameters.description_zh: 要打通的客户端的vSwitch列表，会将这些vSwitch对应的网段加入到服务端的回包路由中。
parameters.help_en: The vSwitches of the clients that you want to connect to. After this parameter is specified, the CIDR blocks of these vSwitches are added to the back-to-origin route of the server
parameters.help_zh: 要打通的客户端的vSwitch列表，会将这些vSwitch对应的网段加入到服务端的回包路由中
parameters.name: vswitch_id_list

parameters.description_en: The CIDR blocks of the clients that you want to connect to. After this parameter is specified, the CIDR blocks are added to the back-to-origin route of the server. Either this parameter or the VSwitchIdList parameter can be used to determine CIDR blocks.
parameters.description_zh: 要打通的客户端的网段信息，会将该网段加入到服务端的回包路由中，与vSwitchIdList可二选一。
parameters.help_en: The CIDR blocks of the clients that you want to connect to. After this parameter is specified, the CIDR blocks are added to the back-to-origin route of the server. Either this parameter or the VSwitchIdList parameter can be used to determine CIDR blocks
